name: Nasu Miiko
source: Head of the Survival Game Club. Has a gun that shoots Mahjong tiles, she causes injuries to several students at the academy. Works as the assassin for the Four Heavenly Kings to get in their good graces. Plays Mahjong as an outlet for her anger.
